c1ec407a6df510b1ef272075ca397e45cb387a16.summary: The page is titled as a report on CaddyWiper, a wiper malware said to target Ukrainian organizations, and carries an IBM byline. The body contains no threat content: only a long list of IBM-owned web properties, a source line and a page count. No actors, dates, tools, techniques, CVEs or figures appear in the text, so nothing can be recorded as a fact.

c133b079fdfe661f8e64e8d0ccf512f5668e1592.summary: Malpedia-style reference page for DarkSide, a ransomware written in C that affiliates can customise per victim (per FireEye). The page is a long list of 2020-2021 reports and headlines covering the Colonial Pipeline attack, reported ransom payments, a claimed $90 million in bitcoin, related actor designations and CISA alerts. Most entries are headlines and report titles, not verified findings.
